1Afei sɛ yɛwɔ saa bɔhyɛ yi nti, adɔfoɔ, momma yɛnhohoro yɛn ho mfiri honam ne honhom mu fi nyinaa ho, na yɛawie yɛn ahoteɛ Onyankopɔn suro mu.
Paulo ne agyidifoɔ ntam dɔ
2 # 2 Ko 12.17; Aso 20.33 Mommue mo akoma mu mma yɛn; yɛnyɛɛ obiara bɔne, yɛnsɛee obiara, yɛnsisii obiara. 3#2 Ko 6.11-13 Menka yei wɔ afobuo kwan so; ɛfiri sɛ maka dada sɛ, sɛ yɛwu oo, yɛte ase oo, mohyɛ yɛn akoma mu. 4Mewɔ akokoɔduro kɛseɛ wɔ mo ho, mewɔ mo ho ahohoahoa pii; awerɛkyekyerɛ ahyɛ me ma, na m’anigyeɛ aboro so pii yɛn ahohia nyinaa mu.
Tito ba a ɔbaeɛ
5 # Aso 20.1-2 Na yɛbaa Makedonia no nso, yɛn honam annya ahome biara, na mmom yɛn ho hiahiaa yɛn afa nyinaa: Ɔko atwa yɛn ho ahyia, na ehu ahyɛ yɛn mu ma; 6#2 Ko 1.3-4; 2.13 nanso Onyankopɔn a ɔkyekyere ahobrɛaseɛfoɔ werɛ no de Tito ba a ɔbaeɛ no kyekyeree yɛn werɛ. 7Na ɛnyɛ ne ba no nko ara, na mmom awerɛkyekyerɛ nso a ɔnyaa no mo ho berɛ a ɔkaa mo anigyina wɔ yɛn ho, mo awerɛhodie, me ho mmɔden a mobɔ a ɛmaa m’ani gyee pii kyerɛɛ yɛn no.
Korintofoɔ ahonu
8 # 2 Ko 2.4 Na sɛ mede me krataa no maa mo werɛ hoo mpo a, (mennu me ho); na sɛ menuu me ho nso a, na mehunu sɛ krataa no, sɛ ɛyɛ dɔnhwereɛ pɛ mpo a, ɛhoo mo werɛ. 9Afei m’ani agye, ɛnyɛ sɛ mo werɛ hoeɛ ntira, na mmom sɛ mo werɛ ho kɔɔ adwensakyera mu; ɛfiri sɛ mo werɛ hoo Nyankopɔn kwan so, na yɛn nti moanhwere biribi wɔ biribiara mu. 10#Mat 27.3-5 Na Nyankopɔn kwan so awerɛhoɔ yɛ adwensakyera a ɛde kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, a wɔnnu wɔn ho wɔ ho; na ewiase awerɛhoɔ deɛ, ɛma owuo.
11Na mo werɛ a ɛhoo Nyankopɔn kwan soɔ no ara, monhwɛ nsiyɛ korɔ a ɛmaa mo, ɛne anoyie ne ahi ne ehu ne anigyina ne mmɔdemmɔ ne aweretɔ!
Na biribiara mu no moyii mo ho kyerɛɛ sɛ mo ho te, asɛm no mu. 12Enti sɛ metwerɛɛ mo a, na ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔne no ntira, nso ɛnyɛ deɛ wɔyɛɛ no bɔne no ntira, na mmom sɛdeɛ nsiyɛ a mowɔ no yɛn ho no bɛda adi mo Nyankopɔn anim.
Paulo anidasoɔ baa mu
13Yei nti yɛn werɛ akyekye. Na yɛn awerɛkyekyerɛ yi mu yɛn ani gye boroo so, ɛnam Tito anigyeɛ no nti, ɛfiri sɛ mo nyinaa momaa ne honhom nyaa ahotɔ. 14Na sɛ mede mo mehoahoa me ho mekyerɛɛ no a, m’ani anwu, na mmom sɛdeɛ yɛkaa mo nsɛm nyinaa nokorɛ mu no, saa ara nso na yɛn ahoahoa a yɛhoahoaa yɛn ho wɔ Tito anim no ayɛ nokorɛ. 15#2 Ko 2.9 Na n’akoma wɔ mo ho pii boro so, na ɔkae mo nyinaa setie, sɛdeɛ mode suro ne ahopopoɔ gyee no no. 16M’ani agye sɛ biribiara mu mewɔ mo mu awerɛhyɛmu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Afei sɛ yɛwɔ saa bɔhyɛ yi nti, adɔfoɔ, momma yɛnhohoro yɛn ho mfiri honam ne honhom mu fi nyinaa ho, na yɛawie yɛn ahoteɛ Onyankopɔn suro mu.

Mommue mo akoma mu mma yɛn; yɛnyɛɛ obiara bɔne, yɛnsɛee obiara, yɛnsisii obiara. Menka yei wɔ afobuo kwan so; ɛfiri sɛ maka dada sɛ, sɛ yɛwu oo, yɛte ase oo, mohyɛ yɛn akoma mu. Mewɔ akokoɔduro kɛseɛ wɔ mo ho, mewɔ mo ho ahohoahoa pii; awerɛkyekyerɛ ahyɛ me ma, na m’anigyeɛ aboro so pii yɛn ahohia nyinaa mu.

Na yɛbaa Makedonia no nso, yɛn honam annya ahome biara, na mmom yɛn ho hiahiaa yɛn afa nyinaa: Ɔko atwa yɛn ho ahyia, na ehu ahyɛ yɛn mu ma; nanso Onyankopɔn a ɔkyekyere ahobrɛaseɛfoɔ werɛ no de Tito ba a ɔbaeɛ no kyekyeree yɛn werɛ. Na ɛnyɛ ne ba no nko ara, na mmom awerɛkyekyerɛ nso a ɔnyaa no mo ho berɛ a ɔkaa mo anigyina wɔ yɛn ho, mo awerɛhodie, me ho mmɔden a mobɔ a ɛmaa m’ani gyee pii kyerɛɛ yɛn no.

Na sɛ mede me krataa no maa mo werɛ hoo mpo a, (mennu me ho); na sɛ menuu me ho nso a, na mehunu sɛ krataa no, sɛ ɛyɛ dɔnhwereɛ pɛ mpo a, ɛhoo mo werɛ. Afei m’ani agye, ɛnyɛ sɛ mo werɛ hoeɛ ntira, na mmom sɛ mo werɛ ho kɔɔ adwensakyera mu; ɛfiri sɛ mo werɛ hoo Nyankopɔn kwan so, na yɛn nti moanhwere biribi wɔ biribiara mu. Na Nyankopɔn kwan so awerɛhoɔ yɛ adwensakyera a ɛde kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, a wɔnnu wɔn ho wɔ ho; na ewiase awerɛhoɔ deɛ, ɛma owuo.
Na mo werɛ a ɛhoo Nyankopɔn kwan soɔ no ara, monhwɛ nsiyɛ korɔ a ɛmaa mo, ɛne anoyie ne ahi ne ehu ne anigyina ne mmɔdemmɔ ne aweretɔ!
Na biribiara mu no moyii mo ho kyerɛɛ sɛ mo ho te, asɛm no mu. Enti sɛ metwerɛɛ mo a, na ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔne no ntira, nso ɛnyɛ deɛ wɔyɛɛ no bɔne no ntira, na mmom sɛdeɛ nsiyɛ a mowɔ no yɛn ho no bɛda adi mo Nyankopɔn anim.

Yei nti yɛn werɛ akyekye. Na yɛn awerɛkyekyerɛ yi mu yɛn ani gye boroo so, ɛnam Tito anigyeɛ no nti, ɛfiri sɛ mo nyinaa momaa ne honhom nyaa ahotɔ. Na sɛ mede mo mehoahoa me ho mekyerɛɛ no a, m’ani anwu, na mmom sɛdeɛ yɛkaa mo nsɛm nyinaa nokorɛ mu no, saa ara nso na yɛn ahoahoa a yɛhoahoaa yɛn ho wɔ Tito anim no ayɛ nokorɛ. Na n’akoma wɔ mo ho pii boro so, na ɔkae mo nyinaa setie, sɛdeɛ mode suro ne ahopopoɔ gyee no no. M’ani agye sɛ biribiara mu mewɔ mo mu awerɛhyɛmu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
